YouTube link ⬇️
https://youtube.com/shorts/WrV1CYMn094

Bitcoin is the ultimate form of scarcity. In this video, we break down why Bitcoin’s fixed supply of 21 million coins and upcoming Bitcoin halving make BTC the scarcest asset in the world. After the next halving, Bitcoin’s stock-to-flow ratio is projected to approach 250, massively surpassing gold’s stock-to-flow ratio of around 64. As the block reward continues shrinking and Bitcoin mining secures the network, Bitcoin’s scarcity becomes stronger with every cycle.

We’ll cover Bitcoin vs gold, stock-to-flow, Bitcoin halving cycles, scarcity economics, store-of-value theory, and why growing global demand is driving the Bitcoin supply shock narrative. Bitcoin is the ultimate store of value, the hardest money ever created, and a scarce digital asset that more people are racing to accumulate before supply becomes even harder to access.
